sections.heading: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Welcome to Talkeo ("we," "us," or "the Company"). Talkeo is an AI-powered language learning software platform available at talkeo.ai. By accessing or using our Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and Talkeo. The Service is a subscription-based software application. All interactions within the platform are powered entirely by artificial intelligence. No human instructors or consultants are involved in delivering the Service.

sections.heading: 2. Description of Service
paragraphs: Talkeo is an AI conversation platform that helps users practice and improve their language skills through real-time voice interactions. The Service uses speech recognition, natural language processing, and voice synthesis technologies to deliver a personalized experience. Key features include:

The Service is provided as software on an as-is basis. Language learning outcomes vary based on individual effort, consistency, and usage patterns. Talkeo does not guarantee specific learning results or proficiency levels.
bullets: Real-time AI voice conversations with adaptive difficulty
Automatic speech recognition and intelligent feedback
Persistent memory that tracks user progress across sessions
Personalized learning plans generated by AI algorithms
Multi-language support (English, Spanish, Portuguese)

sections.heading: 3. Eligibility
paragraphs: You must be at least 13 years old to use the Service. If you are between 13 and 18 years old, you must have the consent of a parent or legal guardian. By using the Service, you represent and warrant that you meet these eligibility requirements.

sections.heading: 4. Account Registration
paragraphs: To access certain features, you must create an account by providing accurate and complete information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use at founders@talkeo.ai.

sections.heading: 5. Subscription Plans and Pricing
paragraphs: Talkeo offers the following subscription plans:

All paid plans are billed on a monthly recurring basis. Prices are in US Dollars (USD) and do not include applicable taxes, which are calculated at checkout based on your location. We reserve the right to modify pricing with at least 30 days' notice. Price changes take effect at the start of the next billing cycle after the notice period.
bullets: Free: $0/month. 7 minutes of AI conversation practice per day with all core features.
Plus: $9.99 USD/month. 20 minutes of AI conversation practice per day with all core features.
Pro: $19.99 USD/month. 45 minutes of AI conversation practice per day with all core features.

sections.heading: 6. Billing and Payment
paragraphs: Payments are processed through our authorized third-party payment provider. By subscribing to a paid plan, you authorize recurring monthly charges to your selected payment method. You are responsible for keeping your payment information current. If a payment fails, we may suspend access to paid features until the issue is resolved. A grace period of up to 3 days may be provided for payment recovery.

sections.heading: 7. Cancellation
paragraphs: You may cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings or by emailing founders@talkeo.ai. Upon cancellation, your subscription remains active until the end of the current billing period, after which your account reverts to the Free plan. We do not offer partial refunds for unused time within a billing period, except as described in our Refund Policy.

If you are not satisfied within the first 7 days of your initial payment, you may request a full refund by contacting founders@talkeo.ai. Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to the original payment method. This guarantee applies once per customer. For full details, see our Refund Policy.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Talkeo ("we," "us," or "the Company") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share your personal data when you use our AI language learning software platform at talkeo.ai ("the Service"). By using the Service, you consent to the data practices described in this policy.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect the following categories of information:
Account Information: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and language preferences. If you sign up with Google, we receive your name and email from Google's OAuth service.

Voice and Conversation Data: During practice sessions, your voice audio is processed in real-time by our speech recognition provider to convert speech to text. Audio is streamed and processed in real-time. We do not store raw audio recordings. Conversation transcripts and AI-generated learning data (such as detected errors, vocabulary notes, and progress markers) are stored to personalize your experience across sessions.

Usage Data: We collect session metadata including duration, number of interactions, timestamps, detected language level, and feature usage. This data helps us improve the Service and monitor system performance.

Payment Information: Payment details (credit card numbers, billing address) are collected and processed directly by our third-party payment provider. We do not store your full payment card details on our servers. We receive only transaction confirmation data (subscription status, billing dates, plan type).

Device and Technical Data: We automatically collect your IP address, browser type, operating system, device type, and approximate geographic location (country level, derived from IP address) for analytics, security, and service optimization.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use your information for the following purposes:
bullets: Provide the Service: Process your voice input, generate AI responses, and deliver personalized practice sessions.
Personalization: Store learning memories, track progress, adapt difficulty level, and maintain continuity across sessions.
Billing: Process subscription payments, manage plan upgrades/downgrades, and handle refund requests.
Communication: Send service-related emails (account confirmation, billing receipts, important updates). We do not send marketing emails without your explicit consent.
Analytics and Improvement: Analyze aggregate usage patterns to improve our AI models, user experience, and system performance.
Security: Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access.
Legal Compliance: Comply with applicable laws and respond to lawful requests from authorities.

sections.heading: 4. Voice Data Processing
paragraphs: Voice data is a core part of the Service and we treat it with special care:
You may request deletion of all your conversation data at any time by contacting founders@talkeo.ai.
bullets: Real-time processing only: Voice audio is streamed to our speech recognition provider, converted to text, and discarded. Raw audio is not stored on our servers.
Transcripts are stored: Text transcripts of conversations are retained to power the memory and personalization features of the Service.
AI-generated data: The AI generates learning notes (such as detected errors and progress markers) that are stored in your profile to improve future sessions.
No voice biometrics: We do not use your voice data for identification, profiling, or biometric purposes.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Service Providers
paragraphs: We use the following third-party services to operate the platform. Each processes data only as necessary to provide their specific function:

Each provider operates under its own privacy policy and data processing terms. We select providers that maintain appropriate security standards and limit data processing to what is necessary for the Service.
bullets: Supabase: Database hosting and user authentication
LiveKit: Real-time audio/video routing (WebRTC)
Soniox: Speech-to-text processing
Google (Gemini): AI language model for generating responses
Fish Audio: Text-to-speech voice synthesis
Vercel: Web application hosting and analytics
Fly.io: Backend infrastructure hosting

sections.heading: 6. Data Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties. We share data only in the following circumstances:
bullets: With the third-party service providers listed above, solely to operate the Service
When required by law, regulation, or valid legal process
To protect the rights, safety, or property of Talkeo, our users, or the public
In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets (with prior notice to users)

sections.heading: 7. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service. Specifically:
bullets: Account data: Retained while your account is active. Deleted within 30 days of account deletion.
Conversation transcripts and learning data: Retained while your account is active to power personalization. Deleted upon account deletion or upon request.
Usage analytics: Aggregated and anonymized data may be retained indefinitely for service improvement.
Billing records: Retained for up to 7 years as required by tax and financial regulations.
Anonymous demo data: Data from anonymous demo sessions is automatically deleted after 30 days.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
paragraphs: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
To exercise any of these rights, contact us at founders@talkeo.ai. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
bullets: Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Deletion: Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten").
Data Portability: Request an export of your data in a machine-readable format.
Objection: Object to certain processing of your data.
Withdraw Consent: Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time.

sections.heading: 9. International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Your data may be processed in countries other than your country of residence, including the United States, where our infrastructure providers are located. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for international data transfers, including the use of service providers that maintain industry-standard security practices.

sections.heading: 10. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data, including encryption in transit (TLS/SSL), secure authentication mechanisms, access controls, and regular security reviews. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 11. Cookies
paragraphs: We use cookies solely for authentication (to keep you logged in) and essential service functionality. We use Vercel Analytics for aggregate, privacy-friendly website analytics. This does not use cookies and does not track individual users across sites. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.heading: 12. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: The Service is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child under 13 has provided us with personal information, please contact us at founders@talkeo.ai and we will promptly delete the data.

sections.heading: 13. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes via email or a prominent notice on the Service at least 15 days before the changes take effect. Your continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: 14. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy-related questions, data requests, or concerns, contact us:
bullets: Email: founders@talkeo.ai
Founders: founders@talkeo.ai
Website: talkeo.ai

sections.heading: Our Commitment
paragraphs: We want you to be satisfied with Talkeo. We offer clear, fair refund terms so you can subscribe with confidence.

sections.heading: 7-Day Money-Back Guarantee
paragraphs: If you are a new subscriber and are not satisfied with the Service, you may request a full refund within 7 days of your first payment. This guarantee applies once per customer and is valid for first-time subscriptions only (Plus or Pro plan).

sections.heading: Cancellations
paragraphs: You may cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings or by emailing founders@talkeo.ai. Upon cancellation:
bullets: Your subscription remains active until the end of the current billing period.
After the billing period ends, your account reverts to the Free plan.
Your learning data (memories, progress, session history) is preserved.
We do not provide partial refunds for unused time after the 7-day guarantee window.

sections.heading: Exceptions
paragraphs: We may issue refunds outside the standard policy at our discretion in cases of:
If you were charged incorrectly, contact us and we will resolve it promptly.
bullets: Extended service outages that materially affect your ability to use the Service
Billing errors or duplicate charges
Technical issues on our end that prevent normal use

sections.heading: How to Request a Refund
paragraphs: To request a refund, email us at founders@talkeo.ai with your account email and a brief description of the reason. We process refund requests within 5 business days. Refunds are issued to the original payment method and may take an additional 5–10 business days to appear on your statement, depending on your payment provider.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy? Contact us at founders@talkeo.ai.
